evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2020-01-01"} returned 201 with "dueDate":"2020-01-01". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain calendar date with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2020-05-05"} returned 200 and the new date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "23.10.2026" and "2026-10-23T10:00:00" each returned HTTP 400. PATCH with "2026-13-01" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-23. I created todos with due dates 2020-01-01 (open), 2099-01-01, 2026-10-23 (today), none, and 2020-01-01 marked done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the open 2020-01-01 todo. The future, today, no-date and done todos were excluded.
evidence.AC5: The page at / shows "(fällig: 01.01.2020)", "(fällig: 01.01.2099)" and "(fällig: 23.10.2026)" next to the matching todos. The todo without a due date shows no date.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the open todo due 2020-01-01 carried the text "überfällig". The future, today, no-date and done-with-past-date todos did not.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only the overdue todo "past".
